== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Captain Lennox (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Captain Lennox (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>f8ce247862d2981fdc5124368f1c848499c211e9</code>.
